name: budget-check
description: Pre-wave usage gate. Before launching an expensive multi-agent wave or fan-out, check the active usage block against a threshold (default 95%) via `ccusage` and return go / no-go / unknown — fail-closed, never a fabricated go. Trigger via /budget-check, or as a reflex before any large dispatch. Not /ask-gate (governs a handler-facing question) or /orchestrate-mode and /multi-agent-mode (which run the wave) — budget-check only decides whether the wave should start.

findings.excerpt: node <skill-dir>/references/tools/budget-check.mjs                  # go/no-go vs 95% of your historical-peak block
const out = execSync('ccusage blocks --json', { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'], timeout: 120000 });
